The '''''Explorer''''' was a modified [[Multi-environment Space Boat]] refitted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] for a mission to [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It was a equipped with a class .5 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]], [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines, allowing it to travel in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], space, [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], or underwater. It required a crew of six (one pilot, one co-pilot, one [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] operator, two gunners, and a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] operator). It could carry six passengers, 150 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo, and four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] worth of consumables. It had two double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] which fired separately as well as a low-power [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]] used as an anchor. It had passive and active [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], including [[Radar/Legends|radar]], [[sonar]], visual scanning, and [[energy-wave detector]]s. For the mission to Sedri, it was equipped with two [[speeder-raft]]s, six [[glider-sail]]s (which could be used for wind sailing), six underwater [[breathing suit]]s with [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]], six [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], two [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], six [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], six [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], two [[spear gun]]s, and four coils of [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]].
